ask: ok this is a mess fix it
sentence: A shared gear list for a trip where each item shows who is bringing it or that it is still open, and anyone in the chat can add, claim, drop or remove items.
use_when: a group is planning a trip and needs to sort out who brings which gear
people want to see which items are still unclaimed
a chat needs a short shared checklist of things to bring with owners
someone wants to add an item and take it at the same time
dont_use_when: the group needs to split costs or track who owes money
the group needs a vote or poll between options
the list is long, with more than 12 items, or needs quantities and categories
the task is a schedule or itinerary with dates and times
